description:

title: Hoodie PK-01
description:
Background: Designed by Emanuel Ricci, this PK-01 Snow Camo Prototype was developed around 04/18/2025, followed by additional versions on 05/12/2025 and 05/14/2025. These early samples featured no zipper and were closer to a traditional hoodie design rather than a Parka. 

It then got redesigned by Taha Elghanai & Muad Elghanai in Spain with Ye on 06/04/2025, evolving it into a Parka and incorporating elements from the Fur Hoodie. 

The final design and development of the PK-01 were completed by PUR3 Inc on 06/15/2025, and the piece was then finished by Dingyun Zhang.
